ability.simplemobheads.allay.tooltip: Dropped items near its wearer float up a little.
ability.simplemobheads.bee.tooltip:
Harvesting a hive or nest does not anger the
bees at its wearer.
ability.simplemobheads.blaze.tooltip:
Magma blocks and campfires do not burn its
wearer.
ability.simplemobheads.breeze.tooltip:
Its wearer, light as the wind, never tramples
farmland.
ability.simplemobheads.cat.tooltip:
Creepers keep their distance from its wearer, as
from a cat.
ability.simplemobheads.cave_spider.toolt: Bare hands cut cobwebs as fast as a sword.
ability.simplemobheads.chicken.tooltip:
Its wearer lays an egg now and then, like a
chicken.
ability.simplemobheads.cow.tooltip:
Another player can milk its wearer with a
bucket.
ability.simplemobheads.drowned.tooltip:
Magma bubble columns do not drag its wearer
down.
ability.simplemobheads.enderman.tooltip: Ender pearl teleports cost its wearer no health.
ability.simplemobheads.fox.tooltip: Sweet berry bushes do not prick its wearer.
ability.simplemobheads.frog.tooltip:
Its wearer jumps higher from lily pads and out
of water.
ability.simplemobheads.goat.tooltip:
A ramming goat only pushes its wearer, without
damage.
ability.simplemobheads.husk.tooltip: Food never gives its wearer Hunger.
ability.simplemobheads.mooshroom.tooltip:
Another player can fill a bowl with mushroom
stew from its wearer.
ability.simplemobheads.pig.tooltip:
Sneak three seconds on grass, dirt or moss: the
truffle nose digs something up.
ability.simplemobheads.polar_bear.toolti: Ice is less slippery for its wearer.
ability.simplemobheads.sheep.tooltip:
Another player can shear its wearer (1-3 wool,
then it grows back).
ability.simplemobheads.shulker.tooltip:
Its wearer opens shulker boxes even when the lid
is blocked.
ability.simplemobheads.silverfish.toolti: Its wearer shrinks to half size.
ability.simplemobheads.slime.tooltip:
Its wearer falls one block further without
damage.
ability.simplemobheads.sniffer.tooltip:
Sneak five seconds on moss, grass or dirt: it
sniffs up seeds.
ability.simplemobheads.spider.tooltip: Cobwebs do not slow its wearer down.
ability.simplemobheads.stray.tooltip: Powder snow does not freeze its wearer.
ability.simplemobheads.turtle.tooltip: Its wearer never tramples turtle eggs.
ability.simplemobheads.warden.tooltip:
Half of its wearer's footsteps never reach
sculk.
ability.simplemobheads.wolf.tooltip: Wild wolves never attack its wearer.
advancements.simplemobheads.heads.head.d: One more head for the collection
advancements.simplemobheads.heads.root.d: Let a charged creeper blow up a mob: it drops its head
commands.simplemobheads.moved: This setting moved to Simple Mobheads: %s
config.simplemobheads.creeperDrops.toolt:
A charged creeper's explosion drops the head
of the mob it kills (one per explosion). Default: true.
config.simplemobheads.enabled.tooltip:
Master switch: drops, abilities and greetings.
The heads always stay in the game. Default: true.
config.simplemobheads.greeting.tooltip:
Sneaking with a mob head on plays its
mob's voice, quietly. Default: true.
config.simplemobheads.playerHeadDrops.to:
A player killed by another player drops
their head with their skin. Default: true.
config.simplemobheads.playerKillChance.t:
Base chance of a player kill (0 to 0.1).
Default: 0.0.
config.simplemobheads.playerKillDrops.to:
A player's kill may drop the head too
(chance below). Default: false.
config.simplemobheads.playerKillLootingB:
Extra chance per Looting level (0 to 0.05).
Default: 0.01.
config.simplemobheads.title: Simple Mobheads
config.simplemobheads.wardenHead.tooltip:
Boss head: the warden drops its head.
Default: true.
config.simplemobheads.witherHead.tooltip:
Boss head: the wither drops its head too.
Default: false.
jei.simplemobheads.boss_head_source: Boss head: only with the server switch, dropped when a charged creeper's explosion kills a %s. No recipe.
jei.simplemobheads.head_source: Dropped when a charged creeper's explosion kills a %s (one head per explosion). The head keeps the mob's variant. No recipe.
ability.simplemobheads.herobrine.tooltip:
Torches near its wearer flicker; in the dark,
hostile mobs hesitate before they attack.
advancements.simplemobheads.heads.herobr: Light the old shrine at night
config.simplemobheads.herobrineRitual.to:
Lighting the gold shrine at night gives
the Herobrine Head. Default: true.
config.simplemobheads.ritualCooldownTick:
Ticks until a shrine or a player may do the
ritual again (1200 to 168000). Default: 24000.
config.simplemobheads.hauntPhase.tooltip:
Five minutes of distant white eyes and steps,
only for the player who lit it. Default: true.
config.simplemobheads.hintBook.tooltip:
A rare book in mineshaft chests hints at
the ritual. Default: true.
book.simplemobheads.herobrine_notes.1: Day 3. Torches I never placed burned out in the mine. Someone walked the tunnel ahead of me. White eyes. No pupils.
book.simplemobheads.herobrine_notes.2: The old builders spoke of a shrine: nine gold blocks, a mossy stone in the middle, four red torches watching it, netherrack on top.
book.simplemobheads.herobrine_notes.3:
Light it only when the sun is gone. He takes the torches and the moss and leaves something behind.

I will not try it.

...I tried it.
jei.simplemobheads.ritual_head_source: No mob drops it. Gold carries moss, moss carries netherrack, four red lights keep watch - light it at night.
config.simplemobheads.technoblade.toolti:
An adult pig named Technoblade wears a crown
and never dies while it does; a player's deadly
hit makes the crown fall as the Crowned Pig Head.
Default: true.
config.simplemobheads.technobladeCooldow:
Ticks until the crown grows back on that pig and
that player may get the next one (1200 to 168000).
Default: 24000.
config.simplemobheads.killerBunnies.tool:
A rare rabbit in flower forests and meadows
spawns as a killer bunny (bites lightly, fast,
always hostile). Default: true.
Chance of such a rabbit to be a killer bunny
(0 to 0.01). Default: 0.001 (1 in 1000).
config.simplemobheads.giantZombies.toolt:
Natural lightning on a full-moon night turns a
zombie of any kind into a giant. Default: true.
config.simplemobheads.giantCows.tooltip:
A cow fed hay bales may grow into a giant cow.
Default: true.
config.simplemobheads.giantCowChance.too:
Chance per hay bale a cow eats (0 to 0.01).
Default: 0.0002 (1 in 5000).
config.simplemobheads.giantCowHayLimit.t:
Hay bales one cow eats at most, then it is full
(1 to 640). Default: 64.

jei.simplemobheads.tribute_head_source: No mob drops it. A pig with a certain name never dies - strike it down, and its crown falls instead. The title screen remembers him.
jei.simplemobheads.giant_head_source: No ordinary zombie drops it. When lightning strikes a zombie under a full moon, something big gets up; only a charged creeper brings its head down.
jei.simplemobheads.giant_cow_head_source: No ordinary cow drops it. A cow fed hay bales, one by one, may very rarely grow into a giant; only a charged creeper brings its head down.
ability.simplemobheads.crowned_pig.toolt:
Pigs nearby turn their heads to its wearer, and
the crown glints.
ability.simplemobheads.giant.tooltip:
Its wearer grows to 1.5x size, steps up whole
blocks and walks a little faster; zombies see it
only half as far, and it works like the head of
its zombie kind (husk, drowned).
ability.simplemobheads.giant_cow.tooltip:
Its wearer grows to 1.5x size and steps up whole
blocks; another player can milk it like a cow.

simplemobheads.guide.page.1.title: Simple Mobheads
simplemobheads.guide.page.1: A head for every mob: a charged creeper's explosion drops it, worn it keeps that mob calm and hides a small secret, placed it decorates, on a note block it speaks.
simplemobheads.guide.page.2.title: A Head for Every Mob
simplemobheads.guide.page.2: 97 heads: every mob of 26.3 that has no Vanilla head, the Simple mods' mobs, and the heads that moved in from Simple Fun and SimpleBuilding, plus four secret heads.
simplemobheads.guide.page.3.title: Charged Creeper Drops
simplemobheads.guide.page.3: Only a charged creeper's explosion drops a mob's head, like Vanilla's creeper, zombie and skeleton heads: one head per explosion. No recipe.
simplemobheads.guide.page.4.title: Variants
simplemobheads.guide.page.4: A head keeps its mob's variant: a Siamese cat drops a Siamese cat head, a red sheep a red sheep head.
simplemobheads.guide.page.5.title: Wearing, Placing, Note Blocks
simplemobheads.guide.page.5: Worn on the head, a mob's head makes that mob see you only half as far (like Vanilla's zombie head). Placed on a note block it plays its mob's voice.
simplemobheads.guide.page.6.title: Head Abilities
simplemobheads.guide.page.6: 28 heads hide a small, harmless ability while worn, each with its own server switch.
simplemobheads.guide.page.7.title: Greeting
simplemobheads.guide.page.7: Sneaking with a mob head on plays its mob's voice quietly with a few notes, at most every five seconds (server switch).
simplemobheads.guide.page.8.title: Player Heads
simplemobheads.guide.page.8: A player killed by another player drops their own head with their skin (server switch, default on; moved in from Simple Fun).
simplemobheads.guide.page.9.title: Server Commands
simplemobheads.guide.page.9: Permission level 2: /simplemobheads pvp headDrops, drops creeper|wither|warden|playerKill, drops playerKillChance|lootingBonus, ability <id>, greeting, enabled.
simplemobheads.guide.page.10.title: Moved In
simplemobheads.guide.page.10: Simple Fun's four animal heads and SimpleBuilding's twelve mob heads are Simple Mobheads heads now; old worlds keep them.
simplemobheads.guide.page.11.title: Simple Mods' Mobs
simplemobheads.guide.page.11: Heads of the Simple mods' mobs (Deceiver, Hollow Howler, Dread, Hollow Watcher, Shellker, Soulfire Blaze,
simplemobheads.guide.page.12.title: Simple Mods' Mobs
simplemobheads.guide.page.12: Blighted and Abyssal Wither, Nibblemite, Dragonmite) are always registered; they drop only when that mod is there.
simplemobheads.guide.page.13.title: Creative Tab
simplemobheads.guide.page.13: Own tab "Simple Mob Heads" with every head and variant; in Functional Blocks and the search tab the heads stand right behind the dragon head.
simplemobheads.guide.page.14.title: He Was Never Removed
simplemobheads.guide.page.14: A secret head that no mob drops. A rare book in mineshaft chests and the Questionary hint at how to get it.
simplemobheads.guide.page.15.title: Technoblade Never Dies
simplemobheads.guide.page.15: A tribute head no mob drops: the Crowned Pig Head. The title screen and the Questionary hint at it.
simplemobheads.guide.page.16.title: Killer Bunny
simplemobheads.guide.page.16: A very rare rabbit is a killer bunny; its head is the rabbit head's Killer Bunny variant.
simplemobheads.guide.page.17.title: Giants
simplemobheads.guide.page.17: Two giant heads, one and a half blocks big: the Giant Head and the Giant Cow Head. Only a charged creeper brings them down.
simplemobheads.guide.page.18.title: Helmets on Heads
simplemobheads.guide.page.18: Right-click a placed head with a helmet and it sits on the head, drawn with the helmet's own armor model. An empty hand takes it off again.
quests.simplemobheads.start.title: Welcome to Simple Mobheads
quests.simplemobheads.start.subtitle: Your free guide
quests.simplemobheads.start.welcome.desc: Craft or pick up a crafting table and claim the Simple Mobheads Guide as a reward. You can also craft it from a book and a skeleton skull.
